atoms.b: Proteins is the second ((++smallest biggest)) food group on the food pyramid. Protein is essential for the body being able to grow and ((++repair damage)) itself. It can be found in foods such as meat, ((++fish oil)), beans, eggs and ((++nuts apples)). Dairy or dairy alternatives like ((++milk bread)), cheese and yoghurt are sources of protein that also provide us with ((++calcium roots)), a mineral which keeps our bones healthy.
